//: Specs, typechecked. They were excluded from every build, which is how 87 calls to a constructor that had gained a required argument stayed invisible until they threw at runtime. Extends the package's own config so it keeps the right lib and types; `noUncheckedIndexedAccess` is off because `expect(rows[0].id)` is a fixture the test just built, and a non-null assertion on it asserts nothing. `declaration` is off because nothing is emitted from a spec, and leaving it on makes a cross-package import of a shared fixture a rootDir error rather than a type error.
